# Setup

```{r setup}
#| message: false
require(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse, lubridate, janitor, zoo, arrow, here, MODISTools, MASS)
select <- dplyr::select   # MASS masks dplyr::select

# ---- Input folder (same convention as root_exc_graphs_full.qmd) ---------------------
# data_dir = folder with the raw inputs, found automatically as the first folder that
# contains df_root_flux_2026.rds. To set it by hand, replace NULL with the path.
# The raw inputs (LI-COR/COMPASS drive) are too large for GitHub: I keep them
# in the Google Drive folder synced to this computer and point data_dir there
data_dir <- NULL
key_file <- "df_root_flux_2026.rds"

if (is.null(data_dir)) {
  qmd_dir <- tryCatch(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), error = function(e) character(0))
  if (length(qmd_dir) == 0 && requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) && rstudioapi::isAvailable())
    qmd_dir <- tryCatch(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path), error = function(e) character(0))
  cands <- unique(c(qmd_dir, getwd(), here::here(), file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw")))
  hit   <- cands[file.exists(file.path(cands, key_file))]
  if (length(hit) == 0)
    hit <- dirname(list.files(here::here(), pattern = paste0("^", key_file, "$"),
                              recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))
  if (length(hit) == 0) stop("Could not find ", key_file, ": set data_dir by hand at the top of the script.")
  data_dir <- hit[1]
}
data_dir <- normalizePath(data_dir, winslash = "/")
message("Input folder: ", data_dir)

# Path of an input file: data_dir first, then the project root. must_exist = FALSE returns
# the path in data_dir for files the script creates itself (downloads saved once).
dfile <- function(name, must_exist = TRUE) {
  cands <- file.path(unique(c(data_dir, here::here())), name)
  hit   <- cands[file.exists(cands)]
  if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[1])
  if (must_exist) stop("File not found: ", name, "\n  looked in: ",
                       paste(dirname(cands), collapse = " | "), call. = FALSE)
  file.path(data_dir, name)
}

# Data kept outside the project (other drives). Only this file reads them; the analysis
# file reads the processed copies (wells_hourly, nutrients_soil).
compass_dir <- "D:/COMPASS_L2-v2-1"
nut_file    <- "C:/Users/rbitten/OneDrive - University of Toledo/Documents/Multiplexer/Nutrients/raw_data_AQ700/nutrients_combined.csv"

# ---- Output folder: the final datasets ---------------------------------------------
# Default: <project root>/data/processed. To set it by hand, replace NULL with the path.
out_dir <- NULL
if (is.null(out_dir)) out_dir <- file.path(here::here(), "data", "processed")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_dir <- normalizePath(out_dir, winslash = "/")
message("Output folder: ", out_dir)

# TRUE: also writes each table as CSV to a temporary file, only to compare sizes
# (the CSV is deleted; only the Parquet is kept). Set FALSE once the format is decided.
compare_formats <- TRUE

# ---- Saving helper ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Writes one Parquet file (zstd compression), reads it back to check rows, columns and
# date-times (instants and time zone), and logs it for data_dictionary.csv.
# Parquet keeps column types (Date, POSIXct with time zone, factor levels), which CSV loses.
ds_log <- list()
save_ds <- function(df, name, description) {
  df   <- dplyr::ungroup(tibble::as_tibble(df))
  path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".parquet"))
  arrow::write_parquet(df, path, compression = "zstd")

  back <- arrow::read_parquet(path)
  stopifnot(nrow(back) == nrow(df), identical(names(back), names(df)))
  for (v in names(df)[vapply(df, inherits, logical(1), what = "POSIXct")]) {
    if (!isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(df[[v]]), as.numeric(back[[v]]))))
      stop(name, ": date-time column ", v, " changed after saving")
    if (!identical(attr(df[[v]], "tzone"), attr(back[[v]], "tzone")))
      warning(name, ": time zone of ", v, " is '", attr(df[[v]], "tzone"), "' in R and '",
              attr(back[[v]], "tzone"), "' in the file (same instants; check the clock time)")
  }

  csv_kb <- NA_real_
  if (compare_formats) {
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
    readr::write_csv(df, tmp)
    csv_kb <- file.size(tmp) / 1024
    unlink(tmp)
  }
  ds_log[[name]] <<- tibble(file = basename(path), description = description,
                            n_rows = nrow(df), n_cols = ncol(df),
                            parquet_kb = round(file.size(path) / 1024), csv_kb = round(csv_kb),
                            columns = paste(names(df), collapse = ", "))
  message(sprintf("saved %-38s %8d rows %4d cols %8.0f KB", basename(path), nrow(df), ncol(df),
                  file.size(path) / 1024))
  invisible(path)
}
```

# Parameters

```{r parameters}
# Same values as in root_exc_graphs_full.qmd ("Setup df for analysis"). They define the
# periods and quality filters used to build the datasets. The analysis file needs the
# same values: they are also saved as study_parameters.parquet at the end.
study_start  <- as.POSIXct("2024-04-05 15:00:00") # first and last flux measurements (hourly data)
study_end    <- as.POSIXct("2025-01-14 16:00:00")
win_start    <- as_date(study_start)               # same period as dates, for daily tables
win_end      <- as_date(study_end)
data_start   <- as.Date("2024-03-25")   # longer period for the wells and the water-balance model
data_end     <- as.Date("2025-05-15")
leafon_start <- as.Date("2024-05-20")              # leaf-on window (fixed dates)
leafon_end   <- as.Date("2024-10-15")

tr_floor    <- -0.49   # TR water-level sensor at ~0.50 m: values at or below are censored
sap_max     <- 0.1     # sap flux at or above this value is a sensor error
swc_min     <- 0.05    # SWC below this value is a sensor error
ts_frozen   <- 0       # days with soil temperature at or below 0 C are excluded (frozen soil)
min_obs_day <- 4       # minimum SWC measurements per port and day
rain_min_mm <- 1       # rain-free day: less than 1 mm

noaa_station <- "9063079"            # NOAA Marblehead, OH (Lake Erie level)
site_lat     <- 41.378165
site_lon     <- -82.508944

# Helper functions (used for the rolling windows of the driver table)
roll_mean_obs <- function(x, k, min_frac = 0.8) {
  zoo::rollapplyr(x, k, function(v) {
    if (length(v) < k || sum(!is.na(v)) < min_frac * k) NA_real_ else mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  }, partial = TRUE, fill = NA)
}
roll_sum_obs <- function(x, k) {
  zoo::rollapplyr(x, k, function(v) if (length(v) < k || anyNA(v)) NA_real_ else sum(v),
                  partial = TRUE, fill = NA)
}
```

# Flux from the raw multiplexer files (Flux_Root_exc_df.qmd)

```{r flux-raw}
# From Flux_Root_exc_df.qmd: combines the multiplexer CSVs, sets the time zone, removes
# duplicates and applies the flux QA/QC, giving df_root_flux_2026.
# rebuild_flux = FALSE (default): reads df_root_flux_2026.rds as before (fast).
# rebuild_flux = TRUE: rebuilds it from the raw CSVs (needs the OneDrive folder) and
# overwrites the .rds. The logic is the same as in Flux_Root_exc_df.qmd, with two changes
# that do not alter the result: the CO2_DRY/R2 diagnostic now uses df_fluxroot2024b (it used
# the table before deduplication, with a different row order), and duplicates are counted
# per TIMESTAMP and PORT before removing them, to confirm that no two ports share a timestamp.
rebuild_flux   <- FALSE
directory_path <- "C:/Users/rbitten/OneDrive - University of Toledo/Documents/Multiplexer/OWC_root_exclusion/multiplexer_data"

if (rebuild_flux) {
  csv_files <- list.files(directory_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  message(length(csv_files), " multiplexer files")

  data_list <- list(); error_files <- c(); headers <- NULL
  for (file in csv_files) {
    tryCatch({
      if (file.info(file)$size > 0) {
        data <- read_csv(file, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)
        if (nrow(data) >= 3) {
          if (is.null(headers)) headers <- as.vector(unlist(data[2, ]))   # header = 2nd line of the first file
          data <- data[-(1:3), ]
          colnames(data) <- headers
          data_list[[length(data_list) + 1]] <- data
        }
      } else message("Empty file: ", file)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error processing file: ", file, ": ", e$message)
      error_files <<- c(error_files, file)
    })
  }
  complete_data <- data.table::rbindlist(data_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  if (length(error_files) > 0) { message("Files with errors:"); print(error_files) }

  data_combined <- complete_data[, 1:51, with = FALSE]   # removing empty columns
  colnames(data_combined) <- trimws(colnames(data_combined))

  df_fluxroot2024 <- data_combined %>%
    mutate(across(c(3, 5:51), ~ na_if(as.numeric(.), -9999)),
           TIMESTAMP = as.POSIXct(paste0(DATE, TIME), format = "%Y%m%d%H%M%S"),
           datetime  = floor_date(TIMESTAMP, "hour"),
           DATE = as.Date(DATE, format = "%Y%m%d"),
           TIME = format(strptime(TIME, format = "%H%M%S"), "%H:%M:%S"),
           Treat = ifelse(PORT %in% c("1", "2", "3", "4"), "Control",
                          ifelse(PORT %in% c("5", "6", "7", "8"), "Root-free", PORT)),
           Treat = as.factor(Treat))

  # Logger clock = EST without daylight saving (UTC-5)
  df_fluxroot2024b <- df_fluxroot2024 %>%
    mutate(TIMESTAMP = force_tz(TIMESTAMP, tzone = "Etc/GMT+5"),
           datetime  = floor_date(TIMESTAMP, unit = "hour"))

  # Duplicates (same data saved in more than one file)
  df_fluxroot2024b %>% count(TIMESTAMP, PORT) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% nrow() %>%
    message(" TIMESTAMP x PORT combinations saved more than once")
  df_fluxroot2024b %>% distinct(TIMESTAMP, PORT) %>% count(TIMESTAMP) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% nrow() %>%
    message(" timestamps with more than one PORT (should be 0)")
  df_fluxroot2024b <- df_fluxroot2024b %>%
    arrange(TIMESTAMP) %>%
    distinct(TIMESTAMP, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # QA/QC diagnostics
  num_obs_CO2_DRY <- sum(df_fluxroot2024b$CO2_DRY > 550, na.rm = TRUE)
  num_obs_both    <- sum(df_fluxroot2024b$CO2_DRY > 550 & df_fluxroot2024b$FCO2_R2 > 0.8, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Initial CO2 > 550:", round(100 * num_obs_CO2_DRY / sum(!is.na(df_fluxroot2024b$CO2_DRY)), 2), "% of obs;",
      round(100 * num_obs_both / num_obs_CO2_DRY, 2), "% of those with FCO2 R2 > 0.8 (kept)\n")

  mad_outlier <- function(x, ndev = 2.5) {
    xmed <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE); xmad <- mad(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    xout <- abs(x - xmed) / xmad > ndev
    message("Median = ", signif(xmed, 4), ", MAD = ", signif(xmad, 4), ", outliers = ",
            sum(xout, na.rm = TRUE), " of ", length(xout))
    xout
  }
  df_root_clean <- df_fluxroot2024b %>%
    mutate(FLAG_CO2_Outliers = mad_outlier(FCO2),
           FLAG_CH4_Outliers = mad_outlier(FCH4)) %>%   # flagged only, not removed (bubbles / high fluxes)
    filter(FCH4 != -9999,
           FCO2 != -9999,
           FCO2 > 0,
           !(CO2_DRY > 550 & FCO2_R2 < 0.8),
           FCO2_R2 > 0,
           FCH4_R2 > 0)
  df_root_clean$SWC_1[df_root_clean$SWC_1 == -9999] <- NA
  df_root_clean$TS_1[df_root_clean$TS_1 == -9999]   <- NA
  df_root_clean$SWC_1[df_root_clean$SWC_1 < 0.03]   <- 0.03   # below the detection limit

  df_root_flux_2026 <- df_root_clean %>%
    dplyr::select(DATE, TIME, DOY, PORT, Treat, FCH4, FCH4_R2, FCO2, FCO2_R2, SWC_1, TS_1, TIMESTAMP, datetime) %>%
    filter(!is.na(FCH4)) %>%
    mutate(Treat = as.factor(Treat),
           season = case_when(
             DATE >= as.Date("2024-03-20") & DATE < as.Date("2024-06-22") ~ "Spring",
             DATE >= as.Date("2024-06-22") & DATE < as.Date("2024-09-24") ~ "Summer",
             DATE >= as.Date("2024-09-24") & DATE < as.Date("2024-12-22") ~ "Fall",
             DATE >= as.Date("2024-12-22") & DATE < as.Date("2025-03-20") ~ "Winter",
             DATE >= as.Date("2025-03-20") & DATE < as.Date("2025-06-22") ~ "Spring",
             DATE >= as.Date("2025-06-22") & DATE < as.Date("2025-09-24") ~ "Summer"))
  saveRDS(df_root_flux_2026, dfile("df_root_flux_2026.rds", must_exist = FALSE))
} else {
  df_root_flux_2026 <- readRDS(dfile("df_root_flux_2026.rds"))
}
message("df_root_flux_2026: ", nrow(df_root_flux_2026), " measurements | time zone: ",
        lubridate::tz(df_root_flux_2026$datetime))

# QA/QC'd LI-COR fluxes per measurement (13 columns, ~160 000 rows): a few MB as Parquet,
# so the repository keeps the flux data without the raw files.
save_ds(df_root_flux_2026, "flux_licor_qc_port",
        "LI-COR multiplexer fluxes after QA/QC, one row per chamber measurement: DATE, TIME, DOY, PORT, Treat, FCH4, FCH4_R2, FCO2, FCO2_R2, SWC_1, TS_1, TIMESTAMP, datetime (Etc/GMT+5), season. = df_root_flux_2026")
```

# Hourly weather, sap flux and flux per measurement

```{r hourly}
# From "Preparing df's". df_L1_root and df_sap_OWC were created and QA/QC'd in separate scripts.
# df_L1_root$datetime must be in the same time zone as the flux (Etc/GMT+5) for the join.
df_L1_root        <- readRDS(dfile("df_L1_root.rds"))
if (!identical(lubridate::tz(df_L1_root$datetime), lubridate::tz(df_root_flux_2026$datetime)))
  warning("Time zones differ: df_L1_root '", lubridate::tz(df_L1_root$datetime), "' vs flux '",
          lubridate::tz(df_root_flux_2026$datetime), "'. The join is by instant; check that the clock hours match.")

# Sap flux of the TR trees, hourly per sensor (df_sap_OWC: all synoptic sites after QA/QC).
df_sap_OWC <- readRDS(dfile("df_sap_OWC.rds")) %>%
  mutate(
    TIMESTAMP = ymd_hms(TIMESTAMP),
    F = replace(F, !is.finite(F), NA_real_),
    datetime = floor_date(TIMESTAMP, "hour")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Plot == "TR",
    TIMESTAMP > as.POSIXct("2024-03-25 00:00:00"),
    TIMESTAMP < as.POSIXct("2025-05-15 00:00:00")
  ) %>%
  group_by(datetime, Site, Plot, Sensor_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ if (all(!is.finite(.x))) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        mean(.x[is.finite(.x)])
      }
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Exclude unreliable sap flow:
#   - winter months (sensors not maintained): Nov, Dec, Jan
#   - bad data from 14 Oct 2024 until the end of that winter
sap_bad_months <- c(11, 12, 1)
sap_bad_start  <- as.POSIXct("2024-10-14 00:00:00", tz = lubridate::tz(df_sap_OWC$datetime))
sap_bad_end    <- as.POSIXct("2025-06-01 00:00:00", tz = lubridate::tz(df_sap_OWC$datetime))

sap_is_bad <- function(datetime) {
  month(datetime) %in% sap_bad_months | (datetime >= sap_bad_start & datetime < sap_bad_end)
}

df_sap_OWC <- df_sap_OWC %>%
  mutate(F = if_else(sap_is_bad(datetime), NA_real_, F))

# Sap flux joined to the L1 weather/water-level table, then averaged over sensors per hour.
df_L1_sap_vps_gw <- df_sap_OWC %>% left_join(df_L1_root, by = "datetime")

df_L1_sap_vps_gw <- df_L1_sap_vps_gw %>%
  mutate(gw_hour = 100 * gwl_median,              # transforming m to cm
         DATE = as.Date(datetime, format = "%Y-%m-%d"),
         DOY = yday(datetime))

df_L1_datetime <- df_L1_sap_vps_gw %>%
  select(-Sensor_ID) %>%
  group_by(datetime) %>%
  summarise(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(where(~ !is.numeric(.x)), ~ first(.x)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_L1_filtered <- df_L1_datetime %>% dplyr::select(-c(DATE, DOY))

df_flux_hour <- df_root_flux_2026 %>% left_join(df_L1_filtered, by = "datetime")

L1_flux <- df_flux_hour %>% mutate(season = case_when(
      DATE >= as.Date("2024-03-20") & DATE < as.Date("2024-06-22") ~ "Spring",
      DATE >= as.Date("2024-06-22") & DATE < as.Date("2024-09-24") ~ "Summer",
      DATE >= as.Date("2024-09-24") & DATE < as.Date("2024-12-22") ~ "Fall",
      DATE >= as.Date("2024-12-22") & DATE < as.Date("2025-03-20") ~ "Winter",
      DATE >= as.Date("2025-03-20") & DATE < as.Date("2025-06-22") ~ "Spring",
      DATE >= as.Date("2025-06-22") & DATE < as.Date("2025-09-24") ~ "Summer"
    ))

# ---- Bad soil-temperature records in July (sensor failure, TS_1 <= 1) --------------
ts_july_fail_check <- L1_flux %>%
  filter(month(datetime) == 7, TS_1 <= 1) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  summarise(first_bad = min(datetime), last_bad = max(datetime), n = n())
print(ts_july_fail_check)

ts_july_fail_by_port <- L1_flux %>%
  filter(month(datetime) == 7, TS_1 <= 1) %>%
  group_by(PORT) %>%
  summarise(first_bad = min(datetime), last_bad = max(datetime), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(PORT)
print(ts_july_fail_by_port)

p_ts_raw_port <- ggplot(L1_flux, aes(x = datetime, y = TS_1)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = L1_flux %>% filter(TS_1 <= 1), color = "red", size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~ PORT, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Datetime", y = "Soil Temp - TS_1 (°C, raw)",
       title = "Raw soil temperature by PORT", subtitle = "Red = points with TS_1 <= 1") +
  theme_bw()
print(p_ts_raw_port)

# Overall window (2024-07-11 10:00 to 2024-07-31 15:00) covers every port's failure.
ts_fail_start <- ts_july_fail_check$first_bad
ts_fail_end   <- ts_july_fail_check$last_bad

L1_flux <- L1_flux %>%
  mutate(
    TS_1_flag = if_else(datetime >= ts_fail_start & datetime <= ts_fail_end & TS_1 <= 1,
                        "sensor_failure_july", "ok"),
    TS_1 = if_else(TS_1_flag == "sensor_failure_july", NA_real_, TS_1)
  )

stopifnot(nrow(filter(L1_flux, month(datetime) == 7, TS_1 <= 1)) == 0)   # cleaning worked

# ---- Hourly summary per treatment (median, IQR, mean, SD over the 4 ports) ---------
df_summary_hour <- L1_flux %>%
  group_by(datetime, Treat, season) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_FCH4 = mean((FCH4), na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_FCH4 = sd((FCH4), na.rm = TRUE),
            median_FCH4 = median((FCH4), na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR_FCH4 = IQR((FCH4), na.rm = TRUE),

            mean_SWC = mean((SWC_1), na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_SWC = sd((SWC_1), na.rm = TRUE),
            median_SWC = median((SWC_1), na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR_SWC = IQR((SWC_1), na.rm = TRUE),

            mean_TS = mean((TS_1), na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_TS = sd((TS_1), na.rm = TRUE),
            median_TS = median((TS_1), na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR_TS = IQR((TS_1), na.rm = TRUE),

            mean_FCO2 = mean((FCO2), na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_FCO2 = sd((FCO2), na.rm = TRUE),
            median_FCO2 = median((FCO2), na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR_FCO2 = IQR((FCO2), na.rm = TRUE),

            mean_gwl = mean((gwl_median), na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_gwl = sd((gwl_median), na.rm = TRUE),
            median_gwl = median((gwl_median), na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR_gwl = IQR((gwl_median), na.rm = TRUE),

            mean_sap =  mean(F, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_sap =  sd(F, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_sap =  median(F, na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR_sap = IQR(F, na.rm = TRUE),

            mean_vpd = mean((VPD_hour), na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_vpd = sd((VPD_hour), na.rm = TRUE),
            median_vpd = median((VPD_hour), na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR_vpd = IQR((VPD_hour), na.rm = TRUE),
            n_obs = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(df_L1_datetime %>% dplyr::select(datetime, rain_sum), by = "datetime")   # = df_gamm

save_ds(L1_flux, "flux_measurements_port",
        "Each chamber measurement (multiplexer cycle) of CH4/CO2 flux, SWC_1, TS_1 per port (8 ports) joined to hourly weather, TR water level and sensor-mean sap flux; TS_1 July failure set to NA (TS_1_flag); season. = L1_flux")
save_ds(df_summary_hour, "flux_hourly_treatment",
        "Hourly mean, SD, median, IQR per treatment of FCH4, SWC, TS, FCO2, gwl, sap F, VPD + rain_sum (hours with sap records). = df_summary_hour / df_gamm")
save_ds(df_sap_OWC, "sap_hourly_sensor",
        "TR sap flux density F (Granier) per sensor and hour, 2024-03-25 to 2025-05-15; Nov-Jan and 14 Oct 2024 - 31 May 2025 set to NA. = df_sap_OWC")
save_ds(df_L1_root, "met_watertable_hourly",
        "L1 hourly weather and TR water level (rain_sum, VPD_hour, gwl_median, ...), all hours (use for rain: it is not limited to hours with sap records). = df_L1_root")
```

# Manual measurements: redox and nutrients

```{r manual}
redox_df <- read.csv(dfile("Redox_root_OWC_2024_all.csv")) %>%
  rename(Treat = Treatment) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
         datetime = as.POSIXct(paste(Date, "00:00:00"), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
         depth_f = factor(depth_cm, levels = c(5, 10, 20)),
         Treat = case_when(Treat == "CRT" ~ "Control",
                           Treat == "REX" ~ "Root-free")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(depth_cm),
         datetime <= "2025-01-14 16:00:00 UTC" & datetime >= "2024-04-05 15:00:00 UTC")

nut_clean <- read.csv(nut_file) %>%
  mutate(
    Treat = case_when(
      str_detect(Sample.ID, "trC") ~ "Control",
      str_detect(Sample.ID, "trE") ~ "Root-free",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    Depth = case_when(
      str_detect(Sample.ID, "10cm") ~ "10 cm",
      str_detect(Sample.ID, "20cm") ~ "20 cm",
      str_detect(Sample.ID, "40cm") ~ "40 cm",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treat), !is.na(Depth))

save_ds(redox_df, "redox_manual",
        "Manual redox (mV) and pH by treatment, date and depth (5, 10, 20 cm), study period.")
save_ds(nut_clean, "nutrients_soil",
        "Soil nutrient results (AQ700) for the TR plots with Treat and Depth (10, 20, 40 cm); other samples removed.")
```

# CH4 gap filled per treatment (cumulative flux)

```{r ch4-cumulative}
# From "Prep df for CH4 cumulative flux". Per treatment, hourly, umol m-2 h-1.
L1_fluxsummary <- df_summary_hour %>%
  filter(datetime <= "2025-01-14 16:00:00" & datetime >= "2024-04-05 15:00:00",
         median_FCH4 < 250 & median_FCH4 > -250) %>%   # removing outliers
  mutate(median_FCH4 = median_FCH4 * 3600)             # second -> hour

start_time <- as.POSIXct("2024-04-05 15:00:00")
end_time   <- as.POSIXct("2025-04-05 14:00:00")
all_hours  <- tibble(datetime = seq(from = start_time, to = end_time, by = "1 hour"))
all_treat  <- tibble(Treat = c("Control", "Root-free"))
full_grid  <- crossing(all_treat, all_hours)

L1_flux_complete <- full_grid %>%
  left_join(L1_fluxsummary, by = c("Treat", "datetime")) %>%
  arrange(Treat, datetime) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(datetime), month = month(datetime))

# Linear interpolation of gaps < 24 h
L1_flux_complete <- L1_flux_complete %>%
  group_by(Treat) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  mutate(FCH4_linear = na.approx(median_FCH4, x = datetime, maxgap = 23, na.rm = FALSE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Monthly median per treatment (February takes January if missing)
monthly_median <- L1_flux_complete %>%
  group_by(Treat, month) %>%
  summarise(med_FCH4 = median(median_FCH4, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Treat) %>%
  arrange(month) %>%
  mutate(med_FCH4 = if_else(is.na(med_FCH4) & month == 2, med_FCH4[month == 1], med_FCH4)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Remaining gaps -> monthly median. gap_flag: 0 observed, 1 linear, 2 monthly median
L1_flux_complete <- L1_flux_complete %>%
  left_join(monthly_median, by = c("Treat", "month")) %>%
  mutate(FCH4_GP = ifelse(is.na(FCH4_linear), med_FCH4, FCH4_linear),
         gap_flag = case_when(
           !is.na(median_FCH4) ~ 0,
           is.na(median_FCH4) & !is.na(FCH4_linear) ~ 1,
           is.na(median_FCH4) & is.na(FCH4_linear) ~ 2)) %>%
  select(-FCH4_linear, -med_FCH4)

L1_flux_cumulative <- L1_flux_complete %>%
  mutate(Treat = factor(Treat)) %>%
  arrange(Treat, datetime) %>%
  group_by(Treat) %>%
  arrange(datetime, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(FCH4_cum = cumsum(replace_na(FCH4_GP, 0))) %>%
  ungroup()

L1_flux_cumulative %>% count(Treat, gap_flag) %>% print()

save_ds(L1_flux_cumulative, "ch4_gapfilled_cumulative_treatment",
        "Hourly treatment-median CH4 (umol m-2 h-1) 2024-04-05 to 2025-04-05, gap filled (FCH4_GP; gap_flag 0 observed, 1 linear < 24 h, 2 monthly median) and cumulative (FCH4_cum). = L1_flux_cumulative")
```

```{r drivers}
# Lake Erie level from NOAA, downloaded once and cached in data_dir.
get_noaa_level <- function(station, start, end) {
  months <- seq(floor_date(start, "month"), floor_date(end, "month"), by = "month")
  purrr::map_dfr(months, function(m) {
    url <- paste0("https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/datagetter?",
                  "product=hourly_height&station=", station,
                  "&begin_date=", format(m, "%Y%m%d"),
                  "&end_date=", format(ceiling_date(m, "month") - days(1), "%Y%m%d"),
                  "&datum=IGLD&units=metric&time_zone=lst&format=csv&application=OWC_root_exclusion")
    out <- tryCatch(clean_names(read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(out) || !"water_level" %in% names(out)) return(NULL)
    tibble(datetime   = if (inherits(out$date_time, "POSIXct")) out$date_time else ymd_hm(out$date_time),
           lake_level = as.numeric(out$water_level))
  })
}

  group_by(DATE = as_date(datetime)) %>%
  summarise(lake = mean(lake_level, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(lake_change = lake - lag(lake))

# Daily sap flux proxy: midday median (11-14 h) and daily integral, median across sensors.

# MODIS GPP (MOD17A2HGF, 8-day composites, g C m-2 d-1), cached in data_dir.

}

ring_area_cm2 <- function(dbh_m, depth_mm) {
  r <- dbh_m * 100 / 2
  pi * (r^2 - pmax(r - depth_mm / 10, 0)^2)
}

cores_file <- dfile("bai_data_OWC.csv")
```

# TR water table gap filled (water-balance model)

```{r tr-gapfill}
# From "TR water-balance model for gap filling" and Fix 3 (ensemble with the censoring
# inside the simulation). Same equations and seeds as in root_exc_graphs_full.qmd, so the
# series are identical. The model itself (m_full) is refitted in the analysis file from
# tr_waterbalance_daily (lm, deterministic); its coefficients are also saved here.
#   dTR_t = a * rain_t - b * (TR_{t-1} - WTE_{t-1}) - c * ET_t + d
et_proxy      <- "gpp"
exchange_with <- "WTE"
n_sims        <- 500
res_block     <- 7
n_redraw      <- 50     # residual redraws allowed on a censored day (Fix 3)
set.seed(42)

wb_daily <- wells_daily %>%
  left_join(met_daily %>% dplyr::select(DATE, rain), by = "DATE") %>%
  left_join(drivers_all %>% dplyr::select(DATE, sap_mid, gpp), by = "DATE") %>%
  mutate(down      = .data[[exchange_with]],
         et        = .data[[et_proxy]],
         tr_obs    = !is.na(TR) & TR > tr_floor,
         dTR       = TR - lag(TR),
         grad_prev = lag(TR) - lag(down),
         fit_ok    = tr_obs & lag(tr_obs))

fit_df  <- wb_daily %>% filter(fit_ok, !is.na(rain), !is.na(grad_prev), !is.na(et))
m_hydro <- lm(dTR ~ rain + grad_prev, data = fit_df)
m_full  <- lm(dTR ~ rain + grad_prev + et, data = fit_df)
cat("Fitting days:", nrow(fit_df), "|", format(min(fit_df$DATE)), "to", format(max(fit_df$DATE)), "\n")
print(summary(m_full)$coefficients)

simulate_tr <- function(df, cf, noise = rep(0, nrow(df))) {
  a <- cf[["rain"]]; b <- -cf[["grad_prev"]]; d <- cf[["(Intercept)"]]
  c_et <- if ("et" %in% names(cf)) -cf[["et"]] else 0
  sim <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    if (df$tr_obs[i]) { sim[i] <- df$TR[i]; next }
    if (i == 1 || is.na(sim[i - 1])) next
    if (anyNA(c(df$rain[i], df$down[i - 1]))) { sim[i] <- sim[i - 1]; next }
    et_i <- if (is.na(df$et[i])) 0 else df$et[i]
    sim[i] <- sim[i - 1] + a * df$rain[i] - b * (sim[i - 1] - df$down[i - 1]) - c_et * et_i + d + noise[i]
  }
  sim
}
block_noise <- function(res, n, block) {
  starts <- sample(seq_len(length(res) - block + 1), ceiling(n / block), replace = TRUE)
  unlist(lapply(starts, function(s) res[s:(s + block - 1)]))[seq_len(n)]
}

# (a) Original ensemble (cap at the sensor applied after the simulation): TR_best.
cf_draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(n_sims, coef(m_full), vcov(m_full))
ens <- vapply(seq_len(n_sims), function(k)
  simulate_tr(wb_daily, cf_draws[k, ], noise = block_noise(residuals(m_full), nrow(wb_daily), res_block)),
  numeric(nrow(wb_daily)))
censored_days <- !is.na(wb_daily$TR) & !wb_daily$tr_obs
p_above <- rowMeans(ens > tr_floor, na.rm = TRUE)
ens[censored_days, ] <- pmin(ens[censored_days, ], tr_floor)
q <- apply(ens, 1, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

# (b) Fix 3 ensemble: censoring inside the simulation (used by chain, rain thresholds, diel).
simulate_tr_cens <- function(df, cf, noise = rep(0, nrow(df)), res = numeric(0)) {
  a <- cf[["rain"]]; b <- -cf[["grad_prev"]]; d <- cf[["(Intercept)"]]
  c_et <- if ("et" %in% names(cf)) -cf[["et"]] else 0
  cens <- !is.na(df$TR) & !df$tr_obs
  sim <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
    if (df$tr_obs[i]) { sim[i] <- df$TR[i]; next }
    if (i == 1 || is.na(sim[i - 1])) next
    if (anyNA(c(df$rain[i], df$down[i - 1]))) { sim[i] <- sim[i - 1]; next }
    et_i <- if (is.na(df$et[i])) 0 else df$et[i]
    base <- sim[i - 1] + a * df$rain[i] - b * (sim[i - 1] - df$down[i - 1]) - c_et * et_i + d
    sim[i] <- base + noise[i]
    if (cens[i] && sim[i] > tr_floor) {
      alt <- base + sample(res, n_redraw, replace = TRUE)
      ok <- alt[alt <= tr_floor]
      sim[i] <- if (length(ok) > 0) ok[1] else tr_floor
    }
  }
  sim
}
res_full <- residuals(m_full)
set.seed(42)
ens_c <- vapply(seq_len(n_sims), function(k)
  simulate_tr_cens(wb_daily, cf_draws[k, ],
                   noise = block_noise(res_full, nrow(wb_daily), res_block), res = res_full),
  numeric(nrow(wb_daily)))
q_new <- apply(ens_c, 1, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

# Gap-filled series with flags (from tr_filled) + the Fix 3 quantiles.
rng <- function(x) range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
tr_filled <- wb_daily %>%
  dplyr::select(DATE, TR, tr_obs, rain, et, down) %>%
  mutate(status   = case_when(tr_obs ~ "observed",
                              !is.na(TR) ~ "censored (below sensor)",
                              TRUE ~ "missing (sensor gap)"),
         filled   = !tr_obs,
         TR_best  = if_else(tr_obs, TR, q[2, ]),
         TR_lwr   = if_else(tr_obs, TR, q[1, ]),
         TR_upr   = if_else(tr_obs, TR, q[3, ]),
         ci_width = TR_upr - TR_lwr,
         capped   = status == "censored (below sensor)" & p_above > 0.5,
         grad_sim = lag(TR_best) - lag(down),
         out_of_range = filled & (grad_sim < rng(fit_df$grad_prev)[1] | grad_sim > rng(fit_df$grad_prev)[2] |
                                  (!is.na(et) & (et < rng(fit_df$et)[1] | et > rng(fit_df$et)[2])) |
                                  rain > rng(fit_df$rain)[2]),
         TR_cens_med = q_new[2, ],     # Fix 3 (censored inside) median = tr_main$TR_full
         TR_cens_lwr = q_new[1, ],
         TR_cens_upr = q_new[3, ]) %>%
  group_by(obs_grp = cumsum(tr_obs)) %>%
  mutate(days_since_obs = if_else(obs_grp == 0, NA_real_, as.numeric(row_number() - 1))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-obs_grp, -grad_sim)

tr_filled %>%
  filter(DATE >= win_start, DATE <= win_end) %>%
  group_by(month = floor_date(DATE, "month")) %>%
  summarise(pct_filled = round(100 * mean(filled)),
            TR_best_median = round(median(TR_best, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            TR_cens_median = round(median(TR_cens_med, na.rm = TRUE), 2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Ensemble members, wide: DATE + sim_001 ... sim_500 (= gwl_ens$values).
ens_tbl <- as_tibble(ens_c, .name_repair = ~ sprintf("sim_%03d", seq_along(.x))) %>%
  mutate(DATE = wb_daily$DATE, .before = 1)

coef_tbl <- tibble(term = names(coef(m_full)), estimate = unname(coef(m_full)),
                   se = sqrt(diag(vcov(m_full))), n_fit_days = nrow(fit_df))

save_ds(wb_daily, "tr_waterbalance_daily",
        "Daily table of the TR water-balance model: wells (TR, WTE, W, barrier), rain, sap_mid, gpp, down (= WTE), et (= gpp), tr_obs, dTR, grad_prev, fit_ok. = wb_daily (refit m_full: lm(dTR ~ rain + grad_prev + et) on fit_ok days with complete rain, grad_prev, et)")
save_ds(tr_filled, "tr_watertable_gapfilled_daily",
        "TR water table gap filled: status, TR_best/TR_lwr/TR_upr (original ensemble, 95%), flags capped/out_of_range/days_since_obs, TR_cens_med/lwr/upr (Fix 3 ensemble, censoring inside). = tr_filled + q_new")
save_ds(ens_tbl, "tr_watertable_ensemble_censored",
        "500 members of the Fix 3 gap-fill ensemble (censoring inside), wide: DATE + sim_001..sim_500 (m). = gwl_ens / ens_c")
save_ds(coef_tbl, "tr_waterbalance_coefs",
        "Coefficients of the TR water-balance model m_full (dTR ~ rain + grad_prev + et): estimate, SE, number of fitting days.")
```

# Parameters, data dictionary and format comparison

```{r dictionary}
params <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name,          ~value,                       ~description,
  "study_start",  format(study_start),          "first flux hour",
  "study_end",    format(study_end),            "last flux hour",
  "data_start",   format(data_start),           "start of wells / water-balance period",
  "data_end",     format(data_end),             "end of wells / water-balance period (exclusive)",
  "leafon_start", format(leafon_start),         "leaf-on window start",
  "leafon_end",   format(leafon_end),           "leaf-on window end",
  "tr_floor",     as.character(tr_floor),       "TR sensor floor (m); at or below = censored",
  "sap_max",      as.character(sap_max),        "sap flux >= this is a sensor error",
  "swc_min",      as.character(swc_min),        "SWC < this is a sensor error",
  "ts_frozen",    as.character(ts_frozen),      "days with min soil T <= this are excluded",
  "min_obs_day",  as.character(min_obs_day),    "min SWC obs per port and day",
  "rain_min_mm",  as.character(rain_min_mm),    "rain-free day threshold (mm)",
  "plot_area_m2", as.character(plot_area_m2),   "TR inventory plot area (m2)",
  "as_ag_cm2_m2", as.character(as_ag_cm2_per_m2), "sapwood area per ground area (cm2 m-2)",
  "sy",           as.character(0.001 / coef(m_full)[["rain"]]), "specific yield from m_full (0.001 / rain coef)",
  "tz_flux",      lubridate::tz(L1_flux$datetime), "time zone of the hourly flux datetime")
save_ds(params, "study_parameters", "Periods, thresholds and site constants used to build the datasets (text; convert with as.Date/as.POSIXct/as.numeric).")

dictionary <- bind_rows(ds_log)
readr::write_csv(dictionary, file.path(out_dir, "data_dictionary.csv"))

# Size comparison: Parquet (kept) vs CSV (temporary). GitHub warns above 50 MB per file
# and refuses above 100 MB.
dictionary %>%
  dplyr::select(file, n_rows, n_cols, parquet_kb, csv_kb) %>%
  mutate(csv_over_parquet = round(csv_kb / parquet_kb, 1)) %>%
  bind_rows(summarise(., file = "TOTAL", n_rows = NA, n_cols = NA,
                      parquet_kb = sum(parquet_kb), csv_kb = sum(csv_kb),
                      csv_over_parquet = round(sum(csv_kb) / sum(parquet_kb), 1))) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```
